issues.title: Deepen the orchestration run contract
issues.dod: Armature has a strict orchestration run contract in internal/orchestrate and cmd/armature only acts as a thin imperative shell for orchestration commands.

issues.title: Move orchestration wiring behind a strict internal contract
issues.dod: The orchestration run module owns task truth loading, claim/scope gating, harness setup, dry-run parity, preflight, and lifecycle outcome reporting.

issues.title: Define orchestration run and preflight contracts
issues.dod: internal/orchestrate exposes caller-facing RunRequest, RunResult, PreflightRequest, and PreflightResult contracts. OrchestrateState remains an implementation detail for op-derived state rather than the command/runtime result surface.
acceptance: RunRequest and RunResult types exist in internal/orchestrate
PreflightRequest and PreflightResult types exist in internal/orchestrate

issues.title: Implement repo-backed orchestration run preparation
issues.dod: Repo-backed orchestration run loads and materializes task truth, resolves model and auth, creates harness/git/op-log adapters, renders task context, claims if needed, verifies ownership, evaluates active scope conflicts after claim verification, and preserves dry-run path parity up to explicit side-effect gates.
acceptance: dry-run and mutating run share preparation-path tests
claim-if-needed behavior is covered by tests
scope conflict after claim verification is covered by tests

issues.title: Thin cmd orchestration shells over strict contracts
issues.scope: cmd/armature/orchestrate.go, cmd/armature/worker_run.go, cmd/armature/orchestrate_test.go, cmd/armature/worker_run_test.go, internal/workerruntime/runtime.go, internal/workerruntime/runtime_test.go
issues.dod: arm orchestrate and arm worker run call the same internal orchestration run contract. Command code parses flags, resolves the invoking worker identity, calls run or preflight, and formats results without duplicating harness config, active scope, op-log, git, or rendered context wiring.
acceptance: arm orchestrate dry-run output is driven by RunResult
arm worker run execution uses the same orchestration run contract

issues.title: Record explicit lifecycle outcomes for complete runs
issues.dod: A complete orchestration phase always reports and records an explicit task lifecycle outcome. No committed changes default to a blocked lifecycle outcome unless verification proves the task was already satisfied.
acceptance: no-commit run records a blocked or otherwise explicit lifecycle outcome
phase complete without lifecycle outcome is covered by a failing regression test
